conditions: The binding object has the named property, [[IsWithEnvironment]] is true, the accessed @@unscopables value is an object, and the needed accesses complete normally.
limitations: This concerns one environment record's binding check. Other records in the chain can still bind the name.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or material counterexample affecting applicability.

statement: In ECMAScript 2024, an Object Environment Record marked as a with environment returns false from HasBinding for an otherwise present property when the binding object's @@unscopables value is an object and the same-name flag on that object converts to true.
